name: Nutanix, Inc.
moat_justification: A genuine platform position in enterprise hybrid-cloud infrastructure with real switching costs (hypervisor + storage + management plane embedded in customer data centers) and 86-88% software-like gross margins, plus a Broadcom/VMware-displacement tailwind — but net dollar-based retention is only 106%, Broadcom/Microsoft/AWS/HPE bundle the same layer, Nutanix owns no distribution channel, and SBC runs ~39% of OCF. Moderate/narrow moat, CAP 8.5 years.
fragility_flags: DILUTION: share count growing 7.8%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2017, 2018, 2019 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md

SHARE_SCALE_SUSPECT: latest diluted count 292,183 is 0.00107988x the cover-page count 270,570,179 (outside 1/100-100x); the declared base_override pin 1.35534 carries the base; market cap uses the latest diluted count x 1000 (dei basis: 292,183,000 shares)
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 2.0% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Quality hybrid-cloud platform, moat 5/10 — but at $68.41 the price pre-pays a super-bull decade: weighted IRR 5.78%, IV@15% $16.44; the weighted path clears 15% only at $16.44 or below.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Gartner Leader in distributed hybrid infrastructure; platform migration is a multi-quarter project — real switching friction
Subscription model: $2.55B ARR (+16% YoY), 86-88% gross margins, pricing power evidenced by margin expansion
Broadcom/VMware disruption makes Nutanix the default independent alternative; Dell/Pure/NetApp/Lenovo partnerships widen reach
moat_against: Net dollar-based retention only 106% — weak expansion for a claimed platform
Broadcom (VMware), Microsoft, AWS and HPE bundle the same layer with economics Nutanix cannot match
SBC $357,667,000 in FY2026 (~39% of OCF); basic share count keeps climbing
FY2027 guided headwinds: server supply constraints and elevated hardware prices delaying projects; ~5% workforce restructuring
